episodes.title: Part 1: The Ahmedabad Spark
episodes.break_rationale: Krish and Ananya fall in love during their MBA at IIM Ahmedabad, but at Convocation they vow not to elope, pledging to marry only with both families' full consent.
episodes.recap_text: Punjabi boy Krish Malhotra and Tamil Brahmin girl Ananya Swaminathan cross paths at IIM Ahmedabad. What begins as late-night study sessions soon blossoms into an intense, secret campus romance.
episodes.teaser_next: Krish and Ananya introduce their families at Convocation, unleashing an immediate, hostile clash of cultures.

episodes.title: Part 2: Cultural Crossfire
episodes.break_rationale: An explosive confrontation erupts between Krish's outspoken Punjabi mother Kavita and Ananya's traditional Tamil parents during their first formal meeting.
episodes.recap_text: Krish moves to Delhi while Ananya begins work in Chennai. Attempts to bring their families together collapse into bitter regional prejudices, with Krish's mother fiercely opposing a South Indian daughter-in-law.
episodes.teaser_next: Krish takes a job transfer to Chennai, embarking on a determined mission to win over Ananya's strict parents.

episodes.title: Part 3: The Chennai Mission
episodes.break_rationale: Krish wins over Ananya's family in Chennai, but during the family engagement in Delhi, a devastating fight between their parents breaks the wedding off.
episodes.recap_text: In Chennai, Krish helps Ananya's brother with IIT coaching and wins over her father with a workplace presentation. The Swaminathans agree to the alliance, traveling to Delhi for the engagement.
episodes.teaser_next: Heartbroken and separated, Krish confronts his estranged father Vikram in Delhi as a final, desperate chance to save their love.

episodes.title: Part 4: Two States, One Union
episodes.break_rationale: Krish's estranged father makes an unexpected gesture of reconciliation, reuniting Krish and Ananya for a joyous traditional temple wedding in Chennai.
episodes.recap_text: Devastated by their families' fallout, Krish and Ananya part ways. Seeing his son's agony, Krish's father Vikram travels to Chennai alone to apologize and bring the families together.
episodes.teaser_next: Series finale concludes the beloved romantic comedy-drama miniseries cut of 2 States.
